$comment: Toybox Trials asset manifest. Concept art is reference only and stripped from production builds. World models/textures/audio are code-generated; production UI icons are generated raster assets recorded below.

folders.concepts: Art-direction reference images. Never loaded by the game.
folders.environments: Production environment backdrops (e.g. optional low-end room plate). Empty: the room is built in 3D (src/scene/Room.tsx).
folders.characters: Production character assets. Empty: the contender is built procedurally (src/character/WindupBot.tsx).
folders.props: Production prop assets. Empty: all props are code-built primitives (src/scene/*).
folders.ui: Production UI images, including generated transparent Spellbox ability icons; other UI uses CSS and inline SVG.
folders.audio: Production audio files. Empty: all sound is synthesised at runtime (src/game/audio.ts).

conventions.units: 3D world units are centimetres (1 unit = 1 cm); the contender is 3.5 cm tall.
